overall: The AG found no violation: the Board approved its April 25 minutes on September 18, the third consecutive meeting, which was within the required timeframe because the cancelled May 23 and August 22 meetings did not count.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board failed to approve its April 25 meeting minutes in a timely manner.
allegations.key_passage: As such, we find that the Board approved the minutes of the April 25 meeting in a timely manner when those minutes were approved on September 18, which was the third consecutive Board meeting.
